statement: The frozen existence statement E(8,4) is false: there are no bijection e: Z_70 -> binom([8],4), set D subset Z_70 of size 35, and shifts s_v in Z_70 (v in [8]) such that {t in Z_70 : v in e(t)} = D + s_v for every v.
contribution: A complete elementary nonexistence proof for the first higher-uniformity instance left uncovered by the cited source. Lemma 2.2 forces the shifts into a ten-element quotient, and a complete classification of the resulting two-point translational tilings yields a contradiction in both admissible cases. The accompanying exact enumeration independently corroborates every reduced slice; no priority claim is made beyond the bounded primary-source comparison.
